assumptions.prompt: Combine the reference images into a coherent studio photograph. Preserve the identity, colors, and fine details of each subject.
assumptions.token_count_method: Pinned raw pipeline templates encoded with official tokenizer.json; single-sample, no padding; exclude image_pad positions before fourfold latent expansion. Empty negative prompt is encoded as a space by upstream. System-only chat template renders the system string shown in the pipeline.
